about: The postcommunio of the formulary “6th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: We have been filled with Your gifts, O Lord; grant, we beseech You, that we may be both cleansed by their effect and strengthened by their help. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.
